question.text: Identify the incorrect statement from the given below.

options.text: Lithopone is cheap and possess good covering power
Lithopone is prepared by mixing barium sulphide and zinc sulphate
Lithopone is used in medicine as radiocontrast agent.

solution.text: Lithopone  <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math>  is used as a white pigment.
